title: Battle of Cambrils
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cambrils", at revision 1370435995, opens: "The Battle of Cambrils or the Massacre of Cambrils took place in December 1640 during the Reapers' War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2886888, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1640 battle of the Catalan Revolt". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
